hero.title: Tafeta Label with QR Code

overview.title: About This Service
description: Tafeta Label with QR is our authentication solution specifically for the fashion and textile industry. Each label is produced from high-quality premium tafeta material, equipped with a QR code printed using high-resolution printing technology compliant with ISO/IEC 18004:2015.

This solution is designed to address the fashion industry's unique challenge: how to provide maximum protection against counterfeiting without compromising aesthetics, comfort, and product appeal. Our labels blend seamlessly with product design, withstand repeated washing, and remain easily verifiable by consumers.

features.title: Premium Tafeta Material
features.description: Made from high-quality tafeta material that is soft, durable, and comfortable to wear. This material has been tested to ensure resistance to various fashion product use conditions.

features.title: Superior Wash Resistance
features.description: Labels are designed to withstand 50+ washes without quality degradation. Special printing technology ensures the QR code remains clearly readable even after repeated washing.

features.title: High-Resolution QR Code
features.description: QR code printed with high-resolution printing technology producing sharp, clear, and easy-to-scan codes. Compliant with ISO/IEC 18004:2015 for maximum interoperability.

features.title: Fully Customizable Design
features.description: Label design is fully customizable to your brand identity. From size, shape, color, to integration with your logo and product design elements. Our design team will work together to create the perfect label.

implementation.title: Implementation Flow
implementation.description: A structured implementation process to ensure the quality and success of every fashion label project.

steps.title: Consultation & Analysis
steps.description: In-depth discussion to understand your fashion brand's specific needs, product type, target market, and required security level.

steps.title: Design & Prototyping
steps.description: Our design team creates label mockups according to brand identity and fashion product characteristics. A prototype is produced for approval before mass production.

steps.title: AG Code Production
steps.description: The system generates unique AG codes with a 3-layer algorithm, MD5-hashed, and stored in an ISO/IEC 27000:2016-compliant cloud database.

steps.title: Tafeta Label Production
steps.description: Tafeta labels are produced with high-resolution printing technology, equipped with QR codes and security features per specification. Material is tested for wash resistance.

steps.title: Quality Control
steps.description: Quality checking of labels for printing defects, material resistance, and QR code function. Labels that fail QC are destroyed with standard procedures.

steps.title: Delivery & Implementation
steps.description: Labels are shipped to clients with complete documentation. Our team assists with label application on fashion products and system usage training.

items.q: What is the minimum order for tafeta labels?
items.a: Minimum order quantity (MOQ) varies depending on design complexity and label size. For detailed information and the best quote, please contact our sales team for a direct consultation.

items.q: How long is the tafeta label production time?
items.a: Standard production time is ±14 business days after design approval, in accordance with our service terms. For special needs, the timeline can be discussed further with our team.

items.q: Are tafeta labels resistant to washing?
items.a: Yes, our tafeta labels are designed to withstand 50+ washes without quality degradation. Material and special printing technology ensure the QR code remains clearly readable.

items.q: Can the label design be fully custom?
items.a: Absolutely! Our design team will work with you to create a custom label according to your brand identity. From size, shape, color, to integration with your logo and fashion product design elements.

items.q: What if there are production-defective labels?
items.a: We will compensate with new labels for defects up to 2.5% of total production. Defective code reports are submitted monthly by the client with a notification letter and evidence.

items.q: Are the labels comfortable to wear?
items.a: Yes, our premium tafeta material is very soft and comfortable on the skin. Labels are designed not to interfere with the wearer's comfort, even for products in direct contact with skin.

items.q: Are there solutions other than tafeta labels?
items.a: Yes, we also provide Hologram with QR for various industries. For other technology solutions such as NFC, currently still in the research and development stage. Please contact our team for more information.
